title: Add note
purpose: Add a note, a file, or both to a shipment's timeline at any stage, for example a waybill, a photo or logger output.
summary: Add a note, a file, or both to a shipment's timeline, for example a waybill, a photo or logger output.

tasks.title: Add a note or file
steps: Type the [[Note]], choose an [[Attachment]], or both, and set [[When]].

tasks.title: Record a receipt instead
steps: Use Record receipt on a dispatched shipment.

good_to_know: Notes never change the shipment and cannot be edited or deleted.
Never upload consent forms, signatures or documents that identify a participant.
Files are checked by content, up to 10 MiB.

sections.title: Who can use it
paragraphs: Technicians, managers and administrators, in any state. Notes never change the shipment and cannot be edited or deleted. It opens in the form dialog over the page you came from; without JavaScript it is a page of its own. Cancel returns without saving.

items.label: Note
items.description: Up to 4,000 characters. Do not enter names, signatures, record numbers, birth dates or contact details of a participant.

items.label: Attachment
items.description: PDF, PNG, JPEG, TXT or CSV, up to 10 MiB, checked by content and downloaded as a file. Do not upload consent forms, signatures or any document that identifies a participant. Enter a note, attach a file, or both.

items.label: When
items.description: Required; repository local time, not in the future.

sections.title: Saving
paragraphs: The entry is added to the timeline with your name.
